context: This mirrors repeated Optional value reads in configured move logic: the selected target should be bound once.

checklist.name: Creates requested mover
checklist.description: Creates CardMover.java with moveToTargetIfConfigured(Card, BoardContext, Config) and the requested records.

checklist.name: Composes configured target lookup
checklist.description: Uses config.targetListName().flatMap/name lookup or an equivalent direct Optional composition to find the target BoardList.

checklist.name: Binds target once
checklist.description: Once the target list is selected, uses that BoardList directly rather than repeatedly reopening an Optional with get() or orElseThrow().

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves move behavior
checklist.description: Returns no move for absent config, missing list, and already-current cards; returns Move.toList for a different configured target.

checklist.name: Uses real collection stream appropriately
checklist.description: Keeps the BoardContext list lookup as a real collection stream or an equally readable collection lookup.
